name: Bead of Frost
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, M (a cobalt blue glass bead)/DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-ft. radius
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a chilling missile from a bead that produces a blast of frost damage if you succeed with a ranged touch attack. The cold damage is 1d4 points of damage per caster level, to a maximum of 10d4.
